name: Diabetic hospital
description: Uses a 45–60 g carbohydrate meal target and daily added-sugar and fiber targets.

rules.source: American Diabetes Association, Understanding Carbs: https://diabetes.org/food-nutrition/understanding-carbs (meal carbohydrate needs are individualized; this range is the hospital's target).
Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2020–2025: added sugars under 10% of calories; 50 g is the reference amount for a 2000-kcal diet. https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/
Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2020–2025: 14 g dietary fiber per 1000 kcal; 28 g at 2000 kcal. https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov/
